description: The file is the main application component (AppShell) of a React-based Todo List web application. It manages state persistence, user interactions for creating, editing, deleting, and toggling todos, audit trail logging, role-based access placeholders, and theme switching.

methods.name: addTodo
methods.description: Adds a new todo after validating input, updates state, and logs creation in the audit trail.

methods.name: editTodo
methods.description: Edits an existing todo with validation, reason for change, updates state, and logs update in the audit trail.

methods.name: deleteTodo
methods.description: Deletes a specified todo after user confirmation, updates state, and logs deletion.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a todo, updates state, and logs the action.

methods.name: onThemeToggle
methods.description: Switches the UI theme between light and dark modes.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors by setting a user-friendly message and logging technical details.
